Overview.Name: K. Srinuvasulu
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Improve body composition and achieve healthy weight loss.

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Any 1 fruit (apple, guava, orange or papaya)
Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Option 3: Thick curd (200 g) + any 1 fruit
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (120 g) + vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + soya chunks curry (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + mixed vegetable curry + paneer cubes (100 g)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer cubes (100 g) + cucumber salad
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + soya chunks curry (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + curd (200 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Include paneer, curd or soya chunks every day to meet your protein needs.
Keep a fixed meal routine even on busy school days.
When attending social gatherings, eat a small bowl of curd or a fruit before leaving home to help control portions.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Continue practicing yoga and include a 30-minute walk on most days to support weight loss and overall fitness.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily.
